title: Riyadh — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Riyadh: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Riyadh has a population of 7,676,000. The capital and largest city of Saudi Arabia, a modern metropolis with a booming economy and rich cultural heritage. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 307 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
